bio.title: Software Engineering Student
bio.focus: Machine Learning · Productivity Automation · Java Game-Modding
bio.summary: Third-year Bachelor of Computing student at Belgium Campus who thrives on turning ideas into well-engineered code. Strong grounding in back-end OOP (C#, Java) and budding machine-learning skills, with side work in Java game-mod development. Built a C# quoting tool that cut Mikado's quote prep time by ~60 %, and constantly refine personal productivity utilities (e.g. Zeltimer CLI time-logger). Looking for hands-on projects—from data science tasks to full-stack APIs—to deepen skills and decide specialization.
